name: NYC Mayor's Office of Animal Welfare
region_note: WHO TO CONTACT AS WELL: THE MAYOR'S OFFICE AND YOUR COUNCIL MEMBER
notes: animalwelfare@cityhall.nyc.gov - https://www.nyc.gov/site/animalwelfare/about/contact-us.page - the Mayor's office that coordinates city agencies on animal welfare. The office's head has said publicly that requests for help should go to this address. It is a very small office, so do not expect a quick reply; for anything urgent call 311 or 911. The contact page also has a web form.
section: Report animal abuse — WHO TO CONTACT AS WELL: THE MAYOR'S OFFICE AND YOUR COUNCIL MEMBER

change_log.note: Screenshot sent by a reviewer on 2026-11-09: in a public comment thread, the head of the Mayor's Office of Animal Welfare wrote that they would prefer requests for help go to animalwelfare@cityhall.nyc.gov, to help streamline, and that it is a one-person office. Their personal work address in the same reply is deliberately not published. nyc.gov itself refuses our checks.
